changes_vs_current: Friends, Seinfeld, Office, Simpsons, Big Bang Theory are the top 6 (BoJack and critic picks gone); streaming/animated sitcoms (Family Guy, Bob's Burgers, American Dad) and YouGov favorites (Big Bang, Two and a Half Men, Roseanne) rise; Cheers, Frasier-tier classics, Curb, Arrested Development, 30 Rock, B99, Schitt's Creek, HIMYM, Scrubs, Abbott, New Girl, That '70s Show, Everybody Loves Raymond have no public-poll evidence and fall out.
confidence: low. No sitcom-specific, recent, large US poll was readable (YouGov Ratings sitcom page 404s, Ranker/IMDb blocked); the five sources are partial (top 5 to top 20) and two predate 2019. Top 6 is solid (Friends/Seinfeld/Office/Simpsons/Big Bang appear across several US sources); Family Guy at #1 is an artifact of streaming minutes plus YouGov 2018 and a human should likely put Friends/Seinfeld/Office above it. Positions 8-24 are mostly 1-2 sources and tie-heavy, so Roseanne, Mike & Molly, Munsters, Bewitched are weak. Including the YouGov/CBS 2020 all-time list would have pushed Gilligan's Island/Munsters/Beverly Hillbillies above The Office, so I excluded its numbers. Nothing in any readable source covers Cheers, Arrested Development, Parks (only 2 weak hits), so consider hand-adding Cheers/Parks/Frasier-era staples if the game wants them.
